This mod replaces Smile, BatWing, WoodLamp and IronLamp, and adds some
animation for them. If you don't want them animated, you can also
download Non-Animated ones, which just replace the four items without
animation.

[u][size=6]Install[/size][/u]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=4]Make sure ﻿[/size][size=4]you have installed latest versions of Content Patcher, Content Patcher Animations and SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/size]
[*][size=4]Dowload files which you need and unzip these files.[/size]
[*][size=4]Put the mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder and load up the game. Have fun.[/size]
[/list][size=4][size=3]
[size=6][u]Config[/u]
[/size][/size][/size][size=4]There is a [i]config.json[/i] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each item. Simply change "true" to "false".

The [size=4]Smile[/size] has 5 different colors versions in the [size=4]Non-Animated ones[/size]. They are green, yellow, blue, red and purple. [color=#ffff00][b][u]You [/u][/b][u][b]can only have one of these enabled in the [i]config.json [/i]at one time[/b][/u][/color][b][color=#ffff00].[/color] [/b](Default green)[b]

[code]﻿[/code][size=2]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size]

[/b]此mod替换了史莱姆块、蝙蝠翅膀、木灯和铁灯，并增加了动态效果。如果你不想要动态效果，你可以下载无动态效果版本，它仅仅是替换。

[size=6][u]安装[/u][/size]
1、你必须安装了最新版本的前置[size=4]Content Patcher, Content Patcher Animations 和 SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/size]
2、下载你需要的mod并解压
3、把它放入你的星露谷物语Mods文件夹内，启动游戏。玩得开心。

[u][size=6]控制文件[/size][/u]
解压后的文件夹内有一个[/size][size=4][size=4][i]config.json[/i][/size]文件，你可以控制物品是否替换。只要选择[size=4]"true"（替换） to "false"（不替换）[/size]。

史莱姆块在无动态效果里有5种不同颜色供选择。它们是绿、黄、蓝、红、紫。[b][u]在[size=4][i]config.json[/i][/size]文件里进行选择，不过在同一时间你只能选择其中一种颜色。[/u][/b]（默认绿色）[/size]
